meta.name: Reign of Terror
meta.description:
Also known as "The Black Book".

A movie of the French Revolution, starring Robert Cummings and Richard Basehart.

At the time this was written, the film had a rating of 7.1 on the IMDB.

The MPEG2 file contains NAV packets, so you can load it into dvdAuthorGUI and create a DVD to watch on your television.
